notes: Styling system: CSS custom properties --c-* are set at runtime by app.js he()/B() from HSL values (not from DESIGN.md hex values); spacing/type/radius tokens in styles.css :root. No component library. Source is a minified single-line bundle (app.js, styles.css), so line is 1 and col is the 1-based offset of the quoted _snippet; HTML locations use real line numbers. Findings sharing one cause share one location (e.g. order:-1 for F-0017/F-0020/F-0069/F-0079; .slot:focus{outline:0} for F-0016/F-0026; p() fixed columns for F-0009/F-0010/F-0028/F-0101). F-0042: code hides #permit-wrap immediately when Car is chosen (i() clears the timer), so the rendered 'stays visible' effect likely depends on prior session state; location marked medium. Did not read .eval/ or other evaluators' outputs.
